macros.name: aanmaning
macros.doc: \aanmaning makes the letter an assertive reminder.

macros.name: betaalinstructie
macros.doc: \betaalinstructie{instruc} sets the payment instruction to instruc.

macros.name: betalingstermijn
macros.doc: \betalingstermijn{days} sets the term of payment to days.

macros.name: binnenlandbetaling
macros.doc: \binnenlandbetaling makes the invoice fit for domestic payments.

macros.name: buitenlandbetaling
macros.doc: \buitenlandbetaling makes the invoice fit for foreign payments.

macros.name: factuurtitel
macros.doc: \factuurtitel{title} sets the title of the invoice.

macros.name: herinnering
macros.doc: \herinnering makes the invoice letter a reminder.

macros.name: meerpaginas
macros.doc: If \meerpaginas is used before the factuur, the invoice will automatically split across pages.

macros.name: ovv
macros.doc: Use \ovv{reference} to set a payment reference.
